verdict.rationale: A GPU is not normally operated by natural language, but the evidence shows NVIDIA ships Project G-Assist, an AI assistant on RTX PCs that 'helps you tune, control, and optimize your system,' so the axis applies through that companion software. Support is thin: there is one marketing line, it never explicitly says natural-language commands, and 'Project' suggests experimental status. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input, the scope of GPU settings it can control, availability/maturity details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
